name: Wyald's exposed breach
description: A living tear at the north of the final clearing. Defeat this site's apostle and examine it to seal only this local wound.

name: Wyald's sealed breach
description: A closed wound containing one relic. Examine it to claim the reward once. Nearby existing demons remain.

name: Wyald trail record
description: Broken campaign orders name Wyald, leader of the Black Dogs. His heavy rush needs a clear line: step behind stone when he braces his body. A scratched note points toward Rosine's mist-filled valley. This camp is an adaptation of his pursuit, not a reconstruction of a manga panel.

name: Rosine's exposed breach
description: A living tear at the north of the final clearing. Defeat this site's apostle and examine it to seal only this local wound.

name: Rosine's sealed breach
description: A closed wound containing one relic. Examine it to claim the reward once. Nearby existing demons remain.

name: Rosine trail record
description: Torn travelers' notes describe Rosine's false paradise: winged creatures, cocoons and victims who never came home. A dive needs a clear line; trunks and stone can break it. Other notes connect the trail to the Count's residence. Closing one valley will not undo the Brand.
